stories.short: SpaceX caught Starship's upper stage in the Starbase tower's arms for the first time on 14 Nov, after a 22.5-hour flight of 14 orbits that deployed 26 Starlink satellites. The booster's own catch was called off after a low-fuel alarm and it splashed down. Full reuse of both stages is now within reach.

stories.title: The Federal Reserve's November Financial Stability Report (13 Nov) says AI was the top-cited risk in its survey of 23 market contacts, citing stretched valuations, AI-enabled cyberattacks and complex AI financing, and a box on the data-centre buildout says computing-related debt issuance passed $680bn by October 2026, about five times 2023, with outstanding public debt above $1.1tn
stories.short: The Fed's November Financial Stability Report says AI was the risk most cited by the 23 market contacts it surveyed: stretched valuations, AI-enabled cyberattacks and complex AI financing. It also says debt issued for data centres and computing passed $680bn by October, five times 2023, with over $1.1tn of public debt outstanding.

stories.short: Zelensky says US negotiators floated Ukraine handing over parts of Donbas it still holds in exchange for NATO membership, the first time membership has been tied to land. He refused to cede territory or accept neutrality. Russia has always called Ukraine in NATO a red line.

stories.title: The Pan American Health Organization has concluded that measles has re-established continuous transmission in the US, ending the elimination status won a quarter-century ago, KFF Health News reports; PAHO had planned to announce it on 17 Nov; more than 8,000 people have been sickened in two years, 830+ hospitalised and 13 deaths reported
stories.short: Health authorities have concluded measles is spreading continuously in the US again, ending the elimination status it won 26 years ago, KFF Health News reports. PAHO planned to announce it on 17 Nov. Over two years more than 8,000 people were sickened, 830 hospitalised and 13 died.

stories.title: Google Project Zero drops its '90+30' disclosure policy for 'Full 90' (details published 90 days after a report, fixed or not), moving to 60 days on 2 Feb 2027 and 30 days on 3 Jan 2028, because LLMs have sped up bug finding and patch-to-exploit times; it says it now finds several bugs a week in targets where it once found a few a year
stories.short: Google's Project Zero now publishes vulnerability details 90 days after reporting them, with no extra patch time, falling to 60 days in February 2027 and 30 in January 2028. It says AI has sped up both finding and exploiting bugs, and it now finds several a week where it once found a few a year.

stories.title: Italy's data protection authority fines Meta EUR 805M ($887M) because a Facebook feature that suggests posts from users' phone galleries accessed about 20 million Android users' photos and videos without specific consent; Meta has 60 days to switch it off by default and seek separate consent, and says it will contest the decision
stories.short: Italy's privacy regulator fined Meta EUR 805M ($887M) because a Facebook feature scanned about 20 million Android users' photo galleries for post suggestions without specific consent. Meta must switch it off by default within 60 days and ask separately. Meta says it strongly disagrees and calls the fine disproportionate.

stories.title: Google rolls out a Google Wallet connector in the Gemini app in the US that reads transactions from bank and card accounts linked through Plaid to chart spending, find subscriptions and suggest budgets; it is read-only and opt-in, for adults with Gemini Apps Activity on
stories.short: Google's Gemini app can now read US users' bank and card transactions through Google Wallet and Plaid to chart spending, flag subscriptions and suggest budgets. It is opt-in and read-only: Gemini cannot move money. Unlinking does not automatically delete data already processed, reports say.

stat.label: Gemini's access to linked bank data

stories.title: Google Research reports that Antigravity's /teamwork multi-agent harness on Gemini 4 models helped researchers prove the 2013 Courtade-Kumar conjecture in information theory, close a 2014 gap in adaptive data analysis with Lean-verified bounds and resolve STOC 2024's main open question on combinatorial Boolean matrix multiplication; the tools are now available in Antigravity
stories.short: Google says its Antigravity /teamwork agents, running Gemini 4 models with proof checkers and test suites as referees, helped researchers prove the 2013 Courtade-Kumar conjecture and close other long-open problems, some with Lean-verified proofs. The tools are now available to Antigravity users.

stories.title: Security firm Crissy Field, working with Handelsblatt, analysed 159,041 Lovable-built web apps and found database records containing email addresses readable without login in 7,403 of 24,664 Supabase-backed sites examined, including 80,000+ forum profiles and 200,000+ chat messages, passport details in 1,000+ records and 280,000 customer emails
stories.short: Researchers examined 24,664 apps built with Lovable that load data without login and found 30% exposed records with email addresses, including 200,000 chat messages and passport details. They say this is not a confirmed leak rate, but show how AI-built apps often ship with open databases.

stories.title: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy says Friday's nationwide ground stop came from routine work replacing an old copper line with fibre at a remote FAA facility, where a newly installed router flooded other air traffic control routers with over 1,000 connection attempts every 4-5 seconds, disrupting radar feeds and radio; he said the cause could be faulty hardware, misconfiguration or 'incompetence' by contractor L3Harris, and disruption continued into Sunday
stories.update: Duffy says a copper-to-fibre upgrade at a remote FAA site put in a router that flooded the network; contractor L3Harris named; delays run into Sunday.
stories.short: The FAA's nationwide ground stop came from a copper-to-fibre upgrade at a remote site, where a new router flooded the air traffic network with over 1,000 connection attempts every few seconds, Transportation Secretary Duffy said. He blamed hardware, configuration or contractor L3Harris; delays ran into Sunday.

stories.short: Cursor says the attack that planted backdoored Claude Code extensions in its marketplace began with a key stolen from Fireworks AI.
